title: Phased Execution and Step Signaling
short_description: Enforces strict sequential execution order among concurrently running threads using condition variables, semaphores, or countdown latches.
mental_triggers: Print in order: first() then second() then third() called concurrently by different threads
Coordinate execution phases where thread B must wait until thread A signals completion
Prevent race conditions on order of execution without busy-waiting polling
constraint_signals: Thread scheduling is non-deterministic; threads must block and wake up only when signaled by their predecessor

title: Critical Section Protection and Mutual Exclusion
short_description: Protects shared mutable state by ensuring only one thread executes a critical section at any given time using locks/mutexes.
mental_triggers: Prevent lost updates when multiple threads increment a shared counter
Synchronize read-modify-write cycles on shared data structures
Guard shared resource access with RAII lock guards or synchronized blocks
constraint_signals: Simultaneous writes to shared memory without synchronization cause undefined data races

title: Producer-Consumer & Bounded Queue Coordination
short_description: Coordinates producer threads generating work items and consumer threads processing them via a synchronized queue with wait/notify.
mental_triggers: Design Bounded Blocking Queue with fixed capacity
Manage worker thread pool processing tasks from an incoming task queue
Handle decoupled production and consumption rates with backpressure and no starvation
constraint_signals: Producer must wait when queue is full; consumer must wait when queue is empty

title: Cyclic Barriers and Thread Rendezvous
short_description: Synchronizes a fixed set of threads at a rendezvous barrier, holding each thread until all participants have arrived before proceeding.
mental_triggers: Building H2O: 2 hydrogen threads and 1 oxygen thread must assemble together before creating a molecule
Phased parallel computations where step T+1 requires all threads to complete step T
Reusable barrier for cyclic multi-round execution
constraint_signals: Threads arrive at different times but must release in exact stoichiometric or group ratios

title: Resource Pools and Permit Accounting
short_description: Controls access to a limited pool of identical resources using counting semaphores or token bucket permit management.
mental_triggers: Allow at most K concurrent connections to a resource pool
Rate-limit API requests to a fixed number of permits per time window
Acquire multiple permits atomically from a shared permit pool
constraint_signals: Resource pool size is fixed (K); threads requiring resources block until permits are released back to the pool
